## Checklist

- [ ] `node scripts/check.mjs` passes locally (use `--fix` for formatting).
- [ ] My family lives in `themes/<slug>/` with only `<slug>.json` and `gallery.json`.
- [ ] `version` is raised above the published one if I changed an existing family.
- [ ] Theme ids are new and I will never change them once published.
- [ ] `license` is one of the allowed licenses, and I have the right to publish this under it.
- [ ] If this is a port, the description credits the original and its license allows the port.
- [ ] The name does not contain "Kepler" or "GitKraken" and does not use another project's name without its maintainers' okay.
